pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: call-direction
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="call-direction" continue="true" uuid="7e24ab8a-db66-4013-8db3-f7ae8eda188d">
	<condition field="${call_direction}" expression="^$" break="never">
		<action application="export" data="call_direction=local" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: redial
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="redial" continue="true" uuid="c5b9c998-2a98-48c4-b72c-d5511e712997">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^(redial|\*870)$" break="on-true">
		<action application="transfer" data="${hash(select/${domain_name}-last_dial/${caller_id_number})}"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="" expression="" break="never">
		<action application="hash" data="insert/${domain_name}-last_dial/${caller_id_number}/${destination_number}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: distinctive-ring-local
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="distinctive-ring-local" continue="true" uuid="a1740b2e-154f-4bbe-8344-c6012e6e5b81">
	<condition field="${call_direction}" expression="^local$">
		<action application="set" data="sip_h_Alert-Info=3" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: dx
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="dx" continue="false" uuid="3afff851-1136-46ce-bd4e-5f71b37638fd">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^dx$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="read" data="2 6 'tone_stream://%(10000,0,350,440)' digits 5000 #"/>
		<action application="transfer" data="-bleg ${digits}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: xfer_vm
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="xfer_vm" continue="false" uuid="940138e0-0794-47be-9031-617a844b1154">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^xfer_vm$">
		<action application="read" data="2 6 'tone_stream://%(10000,0,350,440)' digits 30000 #"/>
		<action application="set" data="origination_cancel_key=#"/>
		<action application="set" data="domain_name=${transfer_context}"/>
		<action application="export" data="domain_name=${transfer_context}"/>
		<action application="transfer" data="-bleg *99${digits} XML ${transfer_context}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: delay_echo
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="delay_echo" continue="false" uuid="c65d8f63-d57d-451a-a8a3-3fdbf8b87f31">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9195$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="delay_echo" data="5000"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: milliwatt
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="milliwatt" continue="false" uuid="c4da59ef-3868-4bf9-9b24-fae18553c2f8">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9197$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="playback" data="{loops=-1}tone_stream://%(251,0,1004)"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: follow-me
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="follow-me" continue="false" uuid="da7a7c6c-fe38-4fe7-9ea6-f3f3f0059cd0">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*21$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="lua" data="follow_me.lua"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: talking clock time
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="talking clock time" continue="" uuid="d774dcb6-58d3-4d6e-a70c-2e2a44cc2480">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9170$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="say" data="${default_language} CURRENT_TIME pronounced ${strepoch()}"/>
		<action application="hangup" data=""/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: user_exists
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="user_exists" continue="true" uuid="02ebacbf-38c6-4c96-9038-180915cc3ce4">
	<condition field="${loopback_leg}" expression="^B$" break="never">
		<action application="set" data="domain_name=${context}" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="" expression="">
		<action application="set" data="user_exists=${user_exists id ${destination_number} ${domain_name}}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="from_user_exists=${user_exists id ${sip_from_user} ${sip_from_host}}" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="^true$">
		<action application="set" data="extension_uuid=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var extension_uuid}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="extension_caller_id_name=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var effective_caller_id_name}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="extension_caller_id_number=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var effective_caller_id_number}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_all_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_all_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_all_destination=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_all_destination}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_busy_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_busy_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_busy_destination=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_busy_destination}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_no_answer_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_no_answer_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_no_answer_destination=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_no_answer_destination}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_user_not_registered_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_user_not_registered_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_user_not_registered_destination=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_user_not_registered_destination}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_all_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var forward_all_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="follow_me_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var follow_me_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="do_not_disturb=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var do_not_disturb}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="call_timeout=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var call_timeout}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="missed_call_app=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var missed_call_app}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="missed_call_data=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var missed_call_data}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="toll_allow=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var toll_allow}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="call_screen_enabled=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var call_screen_enabled}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="user_record=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var user_record}" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: caller-details
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="caller-details" continue="true" uuid="89fe692a-67f7-419e-870d-ef9ed9584683">
	<condition field="${caller_destination}" expression="^$" break="never">
		<action application="set" data="caller_destination=${destination_number}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="caller_id_name=${caller_id_name}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="caller_id_number=${caller_id_number}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: global-variables
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="global-variables" continue="true" uuid="db4ec092-9979-48e1-8c8e-02b3f5b5f6bc">
	<condition field="" expression="">
		<action application="set" data="RFC2822_DATE=${strftime(%a, %d %b %Y %T %z)}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: clear_sip_auto_answer
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="clear_sip_auto_answer" continue="true" uuid="cb16cf6b-ecb9-4354-803a-36afa08ac457">
	<condition field="${click_to_call}" expression="true"/>
	<condition field="${sip_h_Call-Info}" expression="answer-after=0">
		<action application="export" data="sip_h_Call-Info="/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: is_local
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="is_local" continue="true" uuid="f5090f8b-a11c-4ac1-9353-6d5920deb6c7">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="false">
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua is_local"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: rtp_has_crypto
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="rtp_has_crypto" continue="true" uuid="62f0cd63-49d8-4e25-8860-00c5413090ba">
	<condition field="${rtp_has_crypto}" expression="^(AEAD_AES_256_GCM_8|AEAD_AES_128_GCM_8|AES_CM_256_HMAC_SHA1_80|AES_CM_192_HMAC_SHA1_80|AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80|AES_CM_256_HMAC_SHA1_32|AES_CM_192_HMAC_SHA1_32|AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_32|AES_CM_128_NULL_AUTH)$">
		<action application="set" data="rtp_secure_media=optional" inline="true"/>
		<action application="export" data="rtp_secure_media=optional" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: default_ringback
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="default_ringback" continue="true" uuid="eb0e01c0-713e-46db-bc0f-58dfd44fdb39">
	<condition field="${ringback}" expression="^$">
		<action application="set" data="ringback=${us-ring}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="transfer_ringback=${us-ring}" inline="true"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: call_return
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="call_return" continue="false" uuid="77779c31-fb6e-44a7-b91b-23d4182ddee6">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*69$">
		<action application="transfer" data="${hash(select/${domain_name}-call_return/${caller_id_number})}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: agent_status
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="agent_status" continue="false" uuid="4a891a95-9b92-490d-9543-f83cb5b35ac5">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*22$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="agent_id=${sip_from_user}"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua agent_status"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^(?:agent\+|\*22)(.+)$">
		<action application="set" data="agent_id=$1"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua agent_status"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: agent_status_id
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="agent_status_id" continue="false" uuid="2c24d93a-609a-4f96-9ecd-adf69c508e8b">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*23$">
		<action application="set" data="agent_id="/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua agent_status"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: agent-status-break
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="agent-status-break" continue="false" uuid="990815fa-6ee5-46f8-88a7-316811425adc">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*24$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="agent_id=${sip_from_user}"/>
		<action application="set" data="agent_action=break"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua agent_status"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^(?:agent\+|\*24)(.+)$">
		<action application="set" data="agent_id=$1"/>
		<action application="set" data="agent_action=break"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua agent_status"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: call_privacy
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="call_privacy" continue="false" uuid="0ca6d122-2fc6-47a7-bb33-686faaa7874b">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*67(\d+)$">
		<action application="privacy" data="full"/>
		<action application="set" data="sip_h_Privacy=id"/>
		<action application="set" data="privacy=yes"/>
		<action application="transfer" data="$1 XML ${context}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: intercept-ext-polycom
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="intercept-ext-polycom" continue="false" uuid="c6b55e82-826a-4efa-bdfb-d53a44bc5f07">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*97(\d+)$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="lua" data="intercept.lua $1"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: att_xfer
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="att_xfer" continue="false" uuid="e16bc8e7-1b34-477e-91cf-267c8513206b">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^att_xfer$">
		<action application="read" data="2 6 'tone_stream://%(10000,0,350,440)' digits 30000 #"/>
		<action application="set" data="origination_cancel_key=#"/>
		<action application="att_xfer" data="user/${digits}@${domain_name}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: extension-to-voicemail
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="extension-to-voicemail" continue="false" uuid="6bd23790-20ac-4b92-b0f8-d2c8b62b8a98">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="^true$"/>
	<condition field="username" expression="^\Q${caller_id_number}\E$"/>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\Q${caller_id_number}\E$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="set" data="record_append=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_action=check"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_id=${caller_id_number}"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_profile=default"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua voicemail"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: send_to_voicemail
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="send_to_voicemail" continue="false" uuid="974a9235-ecbe-44fd-b1f4-bfcf518aed00">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*99(\d{2,10})$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_action=save"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_id=$1"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_profile=default"/>
		<action application="set" data="send_to_voicemail=true"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua voicemail"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: vmain
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="vmain" continue="false" uuid="a9391bf1-1a39-4aa6-ae3e-fcfce1a52bc2">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^vmain$|^\*4000$|^\*98$" break="never">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="set" data="record_append=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_action=check"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_profile=default"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_authorized=false"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua voicemail"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^(vmain$|^\*4000$|^\*98|voicemail\+)(\d{2,12})$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="set" data="record_append=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_action=check"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_id=$2"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_profile=default"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_authorized=false"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua voicemail"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: is_transfer
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="is_transfer" continue="false" uuid="6bf3760b-fd3f-4277-8019-8504e7713eaf">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^is_transfer$"/>
	<condition field="${digits}" expression="^(\d+)$">
		<action application="transfer" data="-aleg ${digits} XML ${context}"/>
		<anti-action application="eval" data="cancel transfer"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: vmain_user
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="vmain_user" continue="false" uuid="6732dcf0-5a3e-4df7-822f-c230b8e7fbd8">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*97$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="set" data="record_append=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_action=check"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_id=${user_name}"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_profile=default"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua voicemail"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: cf
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="cf" continue="false" uuid="af0125bd-9753-456a-a596-ffbf9ec2b0cc">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^cf$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="transfer" data="-both 30${dialed_extension:2} XML ${context}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: echo
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="echo" continue="false" uuid="76553e9f-0bc4-475a-a89a-e01ceb535eb3">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9196$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="echo" data=""/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: please_hold
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="please_hold" continue="true" uuid="483743f3-feed-4c00-9d94-d6002f1e92f6">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="^true$">
		<action application="set" data="transfer_ringback=${hold_music}"/>
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1500"/>
		<action application="playback" data="ivr/ivr-hold_connect_call.wav"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: is_zrtp_secure
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="is_zrtp_secure" continue="true" uuid="2b6dd39e-bf8f-4712-b48f-b5bd9cbdb5b2">
	<condition field="${zrtp_secure_media_confirmed}" expression="^true$">
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="playback" data="misc/call_secured.wav"/>
		<anti-action application="eval" data="not_secure"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: is_secure
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="is_secure" continue="true" uuid="e52e12b2-6a2d-4d4a-8a52-16a2e698cad6">
	<condition field="${sip_via_protocol}" expression="tls"/>
	<condition field="${sip_secure_media_confirmed}" expression="^true$">
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="playback" data="misc/call_secured.wav"/>
		<anti-action application="eval" data="not_secure"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: tone_stream
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="tone_stream" continue="false" uuid="ef4367e3-fead-459e-be28-eab481dec1be">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9198$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="playback" data="{loops=10}tone_stream://path=${conf_dir}/tetris.ttml"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: hold_music
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="hold_music" continue="false" uuid="a5e259dd-d387-4235-9203-d691ce53d5b4">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9664$"/>
	<condition field="${rtp_has_crypto}" expression="^(AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_32|AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80)$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="execute_extension" data="is_secure XML ${context}"/>
		<action application="playback" data="${hold_music}"/>
		<anti-action application="answer" data=""/>
		<anti-action application="playback" data="silence_stream://2000"/>
		<anti-action application="playback" data="${hold_music}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: directory
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="directory" continue="false" uuid="dbb78108-7f74-457a-b20f-d09b1286faed">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*411$">
		<action application="lua" data="directory.lua"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: do-not-disturb
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="do-not-disturb" continue="false" uuid="119c788e-8334-412f-8352-9797b26e57c7">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*77$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="enabled=toggle"/>
		<action application="lua" data="do_not_disturb.lua"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*78$|\*363$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="enabled=true"/>
		<action application="lua" data="do_not_disturb.lua"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*79$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="enabled=false"/>
		<action application="lua" data="do_not_disturb.lua"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^dnd\+${caller_id_number}$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="enabled=toggle"/>
		<action application="lua" data="do_not_disturb.lua"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: call-forward
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="call-forward" continue="false" uuid="a2c39700-0f52-4cb8-b707-9ed5d55c9657">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*72(\d{2,20})$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="request_id=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="enabled=true"/>
		<action application="lua" data="call_forward.lua $1"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*72$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="request_id=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="enabled=true"/>
		<action application="lua" data="call_forward.lua"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*73$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="request_id=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="enabled=false"/>
		<action application="lua" data="call_forward.lua"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*74$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="request_id=false"/>
		<action application="set" data="enabled=toggle"/>
		<action application="lua" data="call_forward.lua"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^forward\+(\Q${caller_id_number}\E)(?:\/(\d+))?$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="enabled=toggle"/>
		<action application="set" data="forward_all_destination=$2"/>
		<action application="lua" data="call_forward.lua"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: call-forward-not-registered
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="call-forward-not-registered" continue="" uuid="e5c3c56d-ef2a-4d93-a07a-bff1f61c5f04">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="true"/>
	<condition field="${forward_user_not_registered_enabled}" expression="true"/>
	<condition field="${sofia_contact */${destination_number}@${domain_name}}" expression="error/user_not_registered">
		<action application="transfer" data="${forward_user_not_registered_destination} XML ${domain_name}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: call-forward-all
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="call-forward-all" continue="false" uuid="3c6b7646-afa6-4fa1-867a-e597007d6c39">
	<condition field="${forward_all_enabled}" expression="true"/>
	<condition field="${call_direction}" expression="^local$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="accountcode=${user_data ${destination_number}@${domain_name} var accountcode}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="transfer" data="${forward_all_destination} XML ${domain_name}"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="${forward_all_enabled}" expression="true"/>
	<condition field="${call_direction}" expression="^inbound$" break="on-true">
		<action application="set" data="outbound_caller_id_name=${caller_id_name}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="outbound_caller_id_number=${caller_id_number}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="transfer" data="${forward_all_destination} XML ${domain_name}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: follow-me-destinations
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="follow-me-destinations" continue="false" uuid="2bcdf927-f11c-4b4b-9113-fc578586628e">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="^true$"/>
	<condition field="${follow_me_enabled}" expression="^true$">
		<action application="unset" data="call_timeout" inline="true"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua follow_me"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: talking clock date and time
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="talking clock date and time" continue="" uuid="5936f2a8-6524-4fbb-a6a5-8ebb88c6d2e0">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9172$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="say" data="${default_language} CURRENT_DATE_TIME pronounced ${strepoch()}"/>
		<action application="hangup" data=""/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: talking clock date
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="talking clock date" continue="false" uuid="f33f1540-0acc-45c9-b0df-0a9072f01455">
	<condition field="destination_number" expression="^\*9171$">
		<action application="answer" data=""/>
		<action application="sleep" data="1000"/>
		<action application="say" data="${default_language} CURRENT_DATE pronounced ${strepoch()}"/>
		<action application="hangup" data=""/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: local_extension
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="local_extension" continue="true" uuid="68e4ed22-918f-44fb-894e-ef390b1e2d56">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="true">
		<action application="export" data="dialed_extension=${destination_number}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="limit" data="hash ${domain_name} ${destination_number} ${limit_max} ${limit_destination}" inline="false"/>
	</condition>
	<condition field="" expression="">
		<action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/>
		<action application="set" data="continue_on_fail=true"/>
		<action application="set" data="initial_callee_id_name=${user_data(${dialed_extension}@${domain_name} var effective_caller_id_name)}"/>
		<action application="hash" data="insert/${domain_name}-call_return/${dialed_extension}/${caller_id_number}"/>
		<action application="hash" data="insert/${domain_name}-last_dial_ext/${dialed_extension}/${uuid}"/>
		<action application="set" data="called_party_call_group=${user_data(${dialed_extension}@${domain_name} var call_group)}"/>
		<action application="hash" data="insert/${domain_name}-last_dial/${called_party_call_group}/${uuid}"/>
		<action application="set" data="api_hangup_hook=lua app.lua hangup"/>
		<action application="export" data="domain_name=${domain_name}"/>
		<action application="bridge" data="user/${destination_number}@${domain_name}"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua failure_handler"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: bxfer-return
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="bxfer-return" continue="false" uuid="505f6710-244c-4611-86b7-8de3bc7d5b2b">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="true"/>
	<condition field="${sip_refer_to}" expression="@">
		<action application="transfer" data="${sip_to_user} XML ${domain_name}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: voicemail
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="voicemail" continue="false" uuid="8a5b2177-8e03-45d4-a6b4-1d50b36fbaa3">
	<condition field="${user_exists}" expression="true">
		<action application="set" data="record_append=false" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_action=save" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_id=${destination_number}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="voicemail_profile=default" inline="true"/>
		<action application="lua" data="app.lua voicemail"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: caller-details
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="caller-details" continue="true" uuid="9b6dfbce-b6be-4ecb-89be-1938e1ee51ca">
	<condition field="" expression="" break="never">
		<action application="export" data="call_direction=inbound" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="caller_destination=${sip_to_user}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="caller_id_name=${caller_id_name}" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="caller_id_number=${caller_id_number}"/>
	</condition>
</extension>

pbx_dialplan_defaults.name: not-found
pbx_dialplan_defaults.xml:
<extension name="not-found" continue="false" uuid="d87dd6ce-77e6-49e6-9564-8e5dd260e7bf">
	<condition field="" expression="">
		<action application="export" data="call_direction=inbound" inline="true"/>
		<action application="set" data="call_direction=inbound" inline="true"/>
		<action application="log" data="WARNING [inbound routes] 404 not found ${sip_network_ip} destination_number ${destination_number} sip_to_user ${sip_to_user} sip_req_user ${sip_req_user}"/>
		<action application="respond" data="404 Not Found"/>
	</condition>
</extension>
